transport: authenticated Box web application editor; workflow definition served over private GraphQL at /app-api/graphql
operation: read-only inspection of workflow graphs, followed by owner-approved authoring of one HTTPS connector outcome

authentication.requiredState: operator already authenticated in the intended Box web-app session

captureMethod.graphqlBodiesReason: The browser controller blocked scripted reading of request and response bodies as a credential-exfiltration guard.
captureMethod.definitionSource: The editor's loaded workflow graph, read from client application state after the page finished loading. This is the server-provided definition before any local edit.

bodyEncoding.note: An HTTPS body is stored as an ordered concatenation of operands, not a template string. Each dynamic value is its own operand spliced between literal JSON segments, so a merge-bound value always sits inside quotes contributed by its neighbouring VALUE operands.

operandTypes.VARIABLE: Graph variable addressed by path, for example trigger.form.<formFieldId>.
operandTypes.GET_FILE_METADATA_FIELD: Reads one metadata field. Operands in order: VARIABLE(file path), VALUE(templateKey, METADATA_TEMPLATE_KEY), VALUE(fieldGuid, STRING), VALUE(scope, METADATA_TEMPLATE_SCOPE).
operandTypes.DATE_FORMAT: Renders one component of a date or datetime variable. Component format is encoded as a __YYYY__ style suffix on the token name.

interpretation: A form trigger addresses fields by form element ID, not by label, so rebuilding a Form breaks every binding.
Free-text fields interpolate a token as ${token}; structured fields store {"type":"variable","value":"<token>"}.
A conditional split reads a prior task outcome through static.outcome_<id>.taskStatus with values APPROVED and REJECTED.
There is no YYYY-MM-DD date preset. A date-only value is three DATE_FORMAT operands joined by literal hyphens.

findings: An unresolved variable renders as the literal string 'Variable unavailable'. It is not an empty string and not a null. Observed in a live run, not inferred.
That substitution breaks any typed destination field. A Currency and a Number field each received the phrase and the request was rejected.
The same substitution also propagates into non-connector outcomes, producing a folder renamed to CLM-<year>-Variable unavailable.
Only bind a value whose source field is mandatory. Reconstructing a body with empty strings does not prove blank safety, because the platform never emits empty.
Connector faults surface only as errorCode UNKNOWN_ERROR with an empty payload. The editor's Run Test reports 'Something went wrong'.
The underlying /app-api/graphql call returns HTTP 200 even when the connector call fails, because the failure happens inside the server-side connector invocation.
The fully resolved request body is recorded in the CALL_CONNECTOR run event, which is the only reliable place to diagnose a connector fault.
The endpoint field is a segmented editor. Text typed after a slash is held as a pending variable lookup and is silently dropped from the stored model while remaining visible on screen.
Two similarly named connectors can target different external orgs. A valid payload sent to the wrong org fails indistinguishably from a malformed one.

authoringPhase.note: Workflow save and activation were performed by the owner, not by the agent.
